formulation: There can be no conscious manifestation (prakāśa) devoid of a realization (vimarśa); the internal manifestation is the Lord because it has pratyavamarśa as its essence.

evidence_for.author: isabelle-ratie
evidence_for.claim: There can be no conscious manifestation (prakāśa) devoid of a realization (vimarśa); the internal manifestation is none other than the Lord because it has a realization (pratyavamarśa) as its essence.
evidence_for.quote: there can be no [conscious] manifestation (prakāśa) devoid of a realization (vimarśa)

evidence_for.author: alexis-sanderson
evidence_for.claim: Sanderson reports (Cidvilāsastava) that Śiva and Śakti embody the self-manifest light of reality (prakāśa) and its innate power of creative ideation (vimarśa) as the unitary source.
evidence_for.quote:
embodying the self-manifest light of reality (prakasah) and its 
innate power of creative ideation (vimarsah)

evidence_qualifying_or_against.author: alexis-sanderson
evidence_qualifying_or_against.claim: Sanderson (on Tantrāloka 10.269) reports that in the Fourth state the Light of Consciousness is self-manifest; a distinct claim about manifestation than 'manifestation-not-devoid-of-realization'.
evidence_qualifying_or_against.quote:
the Light of Consciousness is self-manifest and we cannot speak of an 
immersion, except metaphorically

adjudication_question: Does the supporting evidence license the formulation as stated, or does the qualifying evidence require a qualification?

formulation: Liberation is achieved by conviction of one's identity with Śiva; no external cause bestows it.
why_it_matters: Abhinavagupta / Tantrāloka 15.42-43b, as reported by Sanderson

evidence_for.author: alexis-sanderson
evidence_for.claim: Sanderson states (quoting Tantrāloka 15.42-43b) that conviction of one's identity with Śiva is the means of liberation and that no external cause bestows it.
evidence_for.quote:
Conviction of 
one's identity with Siva is the means; no external cause bestows liberation

evidence_for.author: isabelle-ratie
evidence_for.claim: According to Utpaladeva, liberation from the beginningless cycle of rebirths is nothing but the blissful 'recognition' (pratyabhijñā) of oneself as 'the Lord' (īśvara), that is, Śiva.
evidence_for.quote: liberation from the beginningless cycle of rebirths (saṃsāra)

adjudication_question: Does the supporting evidence license the formulation as stated, or does the multi-author evidence require a qualification?

formulation: Inner conviction (a form of knowledge/gnosis), not ritual action per se, is the real means of liberation.

evidence_for.author: alexis-sanderson
evidence_for.claim: Sanderson reports that the inner conviction of identity with Śiva, a form of knowledge, is the real means of liberation.
evidence_for.quote:
This 
inner conviction alone, a form of knowledge, is the real means of liberation

evidence_qualifying_or_against.author: alexis-sanderson
evidence_qualifying_or_against.claim: Sanderson notes that liberation through insight alone and recognition as a Guru without visible ceremonies 'were seen as exceptional' — qualifying the claim that gnosis alone is the means.
evidence_qualifying_or_against.quote:
liberation through insight alone and recognition as a 
Guru without passing through visible ceremonies

adjudication_question: Does the supporting evidence license the formulation as stated, or does the qualifying evidence require a qualification?
